speech.heard: East Timor gets 99.6% of its electricity from oil. In Nigeria, it is 0.04%. East Timor has 142 times the share of electricity from oil that the USA has. The Gambia gets 98.4% from oil, and Chad gets 97.7%. Meanwhile, China runs on just 0.1% oil for electricity, and India gets 0.7%. Georgia, Latvia, Nepal, and Zimbabwe get zero percent of their electricity from oil. What is the primary source of electricity in your country?
